shared_geometry: nominal public radius-inflated AABB segment intersection; UNKNOWN without source envelope; not native clearance certification
cost: same nominal robot route length plus nominal box translation length, weights1+1, metres; source-qualified domain must expose both components, no measured future costs
tie_break: source catalogue order shared; never chosen route/name/hindsight
greedy: minimum immediate common nominal cost among task-relevant source-generated POSSIBLE arcs
multistep: bounded uniform-cost nominal goal search, first action; two or more future semantic skill arcs required by source mapping; explicit same-greedy fallback when no goal found
static_unknown: exclude unknown arcs, never free pass; no known root arc/incomplete root domain means abstain
dynamic_unknown: proposal only, original native judge/guards authoritative; no native success probability/certification
online_replan: after actual observation refresh; never commit hypothetical successor state as actual
scene_initializer_seed: AINav source-qualified same exact configuration/seed for both arms; freeze before dispatch
